messages.subject: Failure on chromosome 11
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I'm running CODEX on a high depth exome sequencing project and it runs well on all chromosomes apart from chromosome 11 where I get the following error:

"Error in smooth.spline(gc_qc, z) :
  NA/NaN/Inf in foreign function call (arg 6)
Calls: normalize2 -> apply -> FUN -> smooth.spline
Execution halted"

Looking at the input and the qcmat.txt I can't see anything that differs from the other chromosomes. Can you think of anything that could be causing this or what I should look for in the input?

Many Thanks,

Tom

messages.subject: Re: Failure on chromosome 11
messages.body_plain:
Hi Tom,

Can you check that all of your exons have non-NA GC content and coverage for chromosome 11? If this is not the reason that you get the error, can you use save.image(file='debug.rda') before the step that you get the error and send the rda file to me? I will look into it.

Cheers,
Yuchao

messages.subject: Re: About length_thresh
messages.body_plain:
Hi Tao,

Yes the default threshold is set fairly arbitrarily. Also it is the lower bound that usually matters -- we want to filter out small exonic targets that aren't efficiently captured.

I pushed some updates in GitHub for CODEX. Please use the code below to update your CODEX package.

install.packages("devtools")
library(devtools)
install_github("yuchaojiang/CODEX/package")

Let me know if you have further questions. I am cc'ing our Google user group in case other users have similar questions.

Cheers,
Yuchao

Sent from my iPhone
